product.name: Xianslate
product.description: A local web app that fetches Chinese web novels, builds a per-book/global glossary, and translates them to English with DeepSeek.
product.problem: Machine-translated CN novels suffer inconsistent names/terms across chapters and poor reading UX; readers want consistent, glossary-pinned translations in a great reader.
product.users: English-speaking readers of Chinese web novels, plus Chinese-language learners who use bilingual side-by-side view and glossaries to study.
goals: Minimal cost via caching + relevant-term injection
A blazing-fast, fully customizable, mobile-responsive reader

tech_stack.database: SQLite + Drizzle ORM (DB layer kept swappable for future Postgres)
tech_stack.infra: Local / self-hosted via adapter-node now; future plan to scale online

workflow.tdd: Flexible — tests recommended for complex logic (parser, matcher, CSV import, glossary precedence)

styleguides.conventions: Generate fresh Prettier + ESLint configs as source of truth
